purpose: Short silent procedure-style proof; not a completed S1-10 lesson or replacement for S1-01.
ownerDecision: Owner rejected merely arranging PPE objects and requested assembly that explains a practical procedure.

source.correction: SRC-005; container and preservation follow receiving-laboratory method

criteria.criterion: Exactly six whole isolated groups in the requested 3x2 order: empty/open bag, filled/open bag, same filled/sealed bag, loaded trowel, loose soil mound, blank label.
The first three cells show the same ivory bag, identical proportions/projection/closure position; contents and closure are the only intended differences.
Both open bag mouths and the third fully closed mouth are visibly distinct; soil remains inside filled bags.
Pure saturated magenta background, no ground/grid/shadow; no translucent magenta bag tint, generous isolation margins.
Complete stainless steel trowel with green handle on right and loaded blade on left, no broken or clipped handle.
Single plain cream blank rectangular label, without ink or generated lettering.
Rounded cartoon 3D with credible soil, metal, matte bag materials, coherent reference style.
No text, numbers, logo, watermark, icons, arrows, hands or people.

compositorGate: Inspect actual states and motion continuity, transfer into the mouth, no tool/container intersection, closure before body label, six editable label groups and matching field record, no invented measured quantity/temperature. No audio or full-video acceptance from this proof.
